text:
elie: Heads up — I'm planning an RBAC change for our private/onprem rollout. Granting ClusterRole 'redwood-admins' to SA 'keystore-connector' in namespace 'redwood-keystore'. Need quick sign-off + audit/telemetry check before we flip it. Oncall?
maria: Which runtime components will get access? just keystore service or runtime pods too?
elie: Primarily the keystore connector (keystore-connector) and the provisioning job that exchanges HSM certs. Runtime pods get readonly access to public certs only, not private keys.
ajay: Quick flag: the audit pipeline for private deploys currently buffers events to the local audit-proxy for 30s then forwards. We need to ensure role-binding change doesn't create a blindspot. Can you paste the kubectl diff?
elie: Sure — here's the RBAC patch I'm applying:```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:
  name: redwood-keystore-admin-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: keystore-connector
  namespace: redwood-keystore
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: redwood-admins
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
(I'll run `kubectl apply -f` in the canary cluster first)
dana: Also worth noting: the network-agent we run in onprem images had a CVE patch recently (network-agent 1.2.4 fixes CVE-2025-xxxx). If we open broader RBAC it increases blast radius. We should pin to 1.2.4 in the keystore daemonset before granting admin-level SA.
elie: Good catch. I'm holding the rollout until we confirm agent version. ajay, can the preflight check include package pin and audit-forwarding?
ajay: Yep — preflight should check: 1) serviceAccount exists and tokens not mounted to pods that don't need them, 2) daemonset image tag != 1.2.3, 3) audit-proxy forwarding path up to central-splunk (health ok), 4) egress rules for keystore connector only to HSM appliance IPs.
elie: sec-bot — run preflight private-keystore-rbac (checks: rbac, audit-forwarding, agent-version, egress)
sec-bot: Preflight started for private-keystore-rbac. Running checks: RBAC diff, SA token mounts, daemonset image scan, audit-forward connectivity, keystore HSM reachability. ETA ~45s.
sec-bot: Results for private-keystore-rbac: RBAC diff ok; SA token mount: WARNING — two runtime pods (runtime-worker-7, runtime-worker-9) mount token: true (should be projected tokens). Daemonset image: FAIL — network-agent v1.2.3 detected on nodes pool-a. Audit-forward: PASS (proxy queued=0, last-forward=12s ago). HSM reachability: PASS (tcp 443 to 10.12.11.5).
maria: Token mount warning is important — we should switch those pods to use projected serviceAccount tokens with minimal audience.
dana: For the agent fail: schedule patch to 1.2.4 and block RBAC change until patch window. Also add runtime-worker nodes to maintenance so we don't roll both at once.
elie: Plan proposed: 1) Re-pin daemonset on pool-a to 1.2.4 and drain one node at a time. 2) Update runtime pods to projected tokens (small change, deploy next window). 3) Re-run sec-bot preflight. 4) If green, apply RBAC change to canary cluster and run audit injection test.
ajay: For the audit injection test: we can create a synthetic key-access event and ensure it surfaces in central logs with keystore-sa identity. Also run a short tabletop sim: "simulated-key-exfil" to validate alerting.
elie: Can we do the tabletop sim Wed 09:00 PT? Need product and infra folks. @maria @dana please confirm. :calendar:
maria: I can do Wed 09:00 PT.
dana: I'm in. I'll prepare the CVE mitigation steps and incident playbook snippets.
sec-bot: Note — I've created ticket SEC-4879 and attached preflight logs. Preflight artifacts: /artifacts/private-keystore-rbac/3625000421-preflight.log.
elie: Thanks. I'll hold the rollout until SEC-4879 is green. Posting the canary apply plan in #release-war-room after we pass preflight. :thumbsup:
